name: reelstorm-academy-os
description: REELSTORM ACADEMY OS — Production OS Factory (STORM OS)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,worker -c magenta,cyan,orange "npm run dev -w @reelstorm/web" "npm run dev -w @reelstorm/api" "npm run dev -w @reelstorm/worker"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @reelstorm/domain -w @reelstorm/db -w @reelstorm/media -w @reelstorm/providers -w @reelstorm/pipeline && npm run build -w @reelstorm/api -w @reelstorm/worker -w @reelstorm/web
